notes: The yields, qualified shares, spread and gain distribution rates are modelling assumptions of this design (tax-rmd-ss 2.6; seams §9 item 7), not sourced figures. us_stock's 1.3% is rounded from the S&P 500 dividend yield of 2025 in the Damodaran workbook (1.34%).

Seams C17: the six classes are blended into the engine's three simulated assets per account and plan year with that year's target weights: a dividend yield and a qualified share for stocks, an interest spread and a tax-exempt share for bonds.

Seams C18: prior_bill_plus_spread pays max(0, previous plan year's bill return + interestSpread) on the post-trade bond balance (for year 0 the return model's starting bill rate). bill_return means the class is the simulated bill asset, which earns the whole actual bill return of the year, taxed with the next year (C17.5); its interestSpread is not read. The fallbackCashYield of the area design is removed: every return model has a bill series.

Seams C19: at the first death basis moves toward value by the share: 1 for the decedent's own account, 0 for the survivor's own, jointAccount (one half) for a joint account, jointAccountCommunityProperty when household.state is in communityPropertyStates.

sources.title: Publication 551 (Rev. December 2025), Basis of Assets
sources.section: Inherited Property (basis is the FMV at the date of death); Community Property (the nine states; the whole community property generally takes that basis); Qualified Joint Interest (one-half is included in the decedent's estate)
